meta.name: migrate-nanoclaw
meta.description: Extracts user customizations from a fork, generates a replayable migration guide, and upgrades to upstream by reapplying customizations on a clean base. Replaces merge-based upgrades with intent-based migration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把分叉代码升级到上游版本并保留自定义修改
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你维护上游项目的分叉,想在不丢失自定义改动的前提下完成升级。
copy.tagline_en: Upgrade your fork to upstream while keeping your custom changes.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a fork and want to upgrade without losing your custom changes.

howto.what: 它从你的 NanoClaw fork 中提取自定义改动,写成一份可重放的迁移指南,再在干净的上游代码上重新应用这些改动完成升级;全程不用 git merge,所以没有合并冲突。
howto.when: 当你想把 NanoClaw fork 升级到上游新版,或要生成、更新迁移指南时会接管;若已存在指南,它会先问你直接升级还是重写指南。

say.text: 帮我把 fork 升级到最新上游
say.note: 先提取改动,再在干净代码上重放

say.text: 提取我的自定义改动,生成迁移指南
已有迁移指南,直接用它升级
say.note: 跳过提取,进入升级阶段

howto.what_en: It pulls your customizations out of your NanoClaw fork into a replayable migration guide, then reapplies them on a clean upstream checkout to upgrade — no git merge, so no merge conflicts.
howto.when_en: Runs when you want to upgrade a NanoClaw fork to newer upstream code, or generate or update a migration guide. If a guide already exists, it first asks whether to skip straight to upgrading.

say_en.text: Upgrade my fork to the latest upstream
say_en.note: Extracts changes, then reapplies them on clean code

say_en.text: Extract my customizations and write the migration guide
A guide already exists — just upgrade with it
say_en.note: Skips extraction and goes to the upgrade phase
